verdict.rationale: Riveter is a data-enrichment SaaS, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its first-party docs describe two connection methods for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP-compatible assistant: a hosted remote server at https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp, added as a custom connector, and a local Node.js server using an API key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, and documentation of which tools and auth scopes it exposes.
